college.vision: To flourish as a center of excellence in engineering and management education by producing technically competent, ethically sound, and socially responsible professionals.
college.mission:
1. Impart quality technical and management education through innovative teaching-learning processes.
2. Develop state-of-the-art laboratories and research culture among students and faculty.
3. Foster industry-academia partnerships for enhanced employability and entrepreneurial skills.
4. Inculcate ethical values, professional discipline, and social commitment.
college.quality_policy: PRPCEM is committed to providing quality education in engineering and management through continual improvement of academic systems, faculty competence, and infrastructure to meet global standards.

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering
departments.description: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers undergraduate (B.Tech) and postgraduate (M.Tech) programs equipped with advanced computing laboratories, Cloud Computing, High-Performance Computing, and AI/ML project labs.
departments.source_title: PRPCEM Department of Computer Science & Engineering

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
departments.description: Specialized B.Tech program focused on Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Neural Networks, and intelligent systems development.

departments.name: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
departments.description: Dedicated department focusing on Big Data Analytics, Statistical Machine Learning, Data Mining, Predictive Modeling, and Business Intelligence.

departments.name: Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
departments.description: Covers Embedded Systems, VLSI Design, Wireless Communications, Signal Processing, and IoT systems with modern spectrum analyzers and simulation software.

departments.name: Electrical Engineering
departments.description: Focuses on Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Electrical Machines, Control Systems, Power Electronics, and Smart Grid technologies.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.description: Covers CAD/CAM/CAE, Thermal Engineering, Fluid Dynamics, Robotics & Automation, Mechatronics, and Advanced Manufacturing.

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.description: Covers Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Transportation, Surveying, and Construction Management.

departments.name: First Year Engineering (Applied Science & Humanities)
departments.description: Provides fundamental foundation in Engineering Mathematics, Applied Physics, Applied Chemistry, Communication Skills, and Basic Engineering Mechanics.

departments.name: Master of Business Administration
departments.description: Two-year postgraduate management program offering specializations in Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, Operations, and Business Analytics.

departments.name: Master of Computer Applications
departments.description: Two-year postgraduate professional program focusing on Enterprise Application Development, Full-Stack Web Development, Data Science, and Mobile Computing.

admissions.btech_eligibility:
1. Passed 10+2 (HSC) examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subject.
2. Obtained at least 45% marks (40% for backward class categories and Persons with Disability belonging to Maharashtra State).
3. Obtained valid non-zero score in MHT-CET or JEE (Main) Paper I.
admissions.direct_second_year_eligibility: Passed Diploma in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category) or B.Sc. Degree with Mathematics at 10+2 level.
admissions.mtech_eligibility: Passed Bachelor Degree in relevant field of Engineering and Technology with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category) with valid GATE score or sponsored criteria.
admissions.mba_eligibility: Passed Bachelor Degree of minimum 3 years duration with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) and valid score in MAH-MBA-CET / CMAT / CAT.
admissions.mca_eligibility: Passed BCA or Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree, or passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 level or Graduation level with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) and valid score in MAH-MCA-CET.

admissions.admission_process: Admissions are conducted centrally by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Government of Maharashtra through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) rounds (DTE Code: 1107). Institute-level/against-CAP vacancy seats are filled strictly on merit as per state government guidelines.
admissions.source_title: Official PRPCEM Admission Portal & DTE Maharashtra Rules

fees.fee_structure_overview: Fees are approved by the Fees Regulating Authority (FRA), Government of Maharashtra. Fee concessions and government scholarship benefits are directly applicable to eligible students.
fees.btech_interim_tuition_fee: Approx. ₹85,000 to ₹95,000 per year (as sanctioned by FRA Maharashtra, subject to category concession)
scholarships: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC - 50% tuition fee waiver for family income <= ₹8.00 Lakhs)
Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Candidates (100% tuition and development fee waiver)
Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / VJNT / SBC Candidates (50% tuition fee waiver for OBC, up to 100% tuition waiver for VJNT/SBC as per norms)
Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vastigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna (Hostel maintenance allowance for children of registered farmers/marginal workers)
Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFWS - 100% tuition fee concession for top 5% meritorious candidates allotted via CAP)
Minority Scholarship (State & Central Government merit-cum-means scholarship for Muslim, Christian, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi, Jain students)
fees.source_title: PRPCEM Fee Structure & Mahadbt Scholarship Guidance

facilities.name: Central Library
facilities.description: Well-stocked air-conditioned library with over 35,000+ volumes, 6,000+ titles, National and International print journals, e-journal subscriptions (IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, DELNET), National Digital Library (NDL) access, multimedia reading room, and 200+ seating capacity reading hall open till late evening.

facilities.name: Hostel Facility
facilities.description: Separate on-campus residential hostels for Boys and Girls with spacious rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, 24/7 security with CCTV surveillance, RO drinking water, hygienic mess serving nutritious food, solar water heating systems, recreational common rooms, and resident wardens.

facilities.name: Computer Centers & High-Speed Internet
facilities.description: Over 1,000+ high-end networked computer workstations powered by Intel Core i7/i5 processors, dedicated 500 Mbps high-speed leased line Internet connectivity, campus-wide secure Wi-Fi, and licensed engineering design and development software.

facilities.name: Training & Placement Cell (T&P)
facilities.description: Proactive Training and Placement Cell providing campus recruitment training, aptitude grooming, coding bootcamps, soft skills sessions, and MOUs with leading industries including TCS, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Cognizant, Wipro, L&T, and Symbiosis.

facilities.name: Sports Complex & Gymnasium
facilities.description: Spacious grounds for Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, and Badminton. Indoor sports facilities for Table Tennis, Chess, and Carrom, along with a fully equipped modern Gymnasium for student fitness.

facilities.name: Canteen & Cafeteria
facilities.description: Spacious, hygienic cafeteria and multicuisine food court serving fresh meals, snacks, beverages, and tea/coffee at subsidized rates for students and staff.

facilities.name: College Bus Transportation
facilities.description: Fleet of college buses operating on multiple routes covering all major points and residential nodes of Amravati city, Badnera, and surrounding suburban areas.

facilities.name: R&D Cell & Incubation Center
facilities.description: Dedicated Research & Development Cell, Patent Support Center, and Institutional Innovation Council (IIC) to nurture startup ideas, patents, paper publications, and student project grants.
